title: Palmer's Point Versus The Umbilicus As Routine Primary Entry Site In Gynecologic Laparoscopy
brief_summary: we will compare the classic method of using the umbilicus as the primary entry site in gynecological laparoscopy with Palmar's point
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients listed for diagnostic or operative laparoscopy.

Exclusion Criteria:

* • Splenomegaly

  * Hepatomegaly
  * previous left upper quadrant surgery.
  * midline laparotomy
  * umbilical surgery
  * presence of umbilical hernia
